description: 1) The agent must read `references/al-amr-al-mutlaq.md` (ignoring the many distractor files in drafts/, notes/, research/, etc.) and also consult `references/templates.md` to understand the required formats. 2) SUMMARY: Must produce a summary with 5–10 bullet-point key points grounded in the reference text (terms like wujub, qarinah, obligation, absolute command), followed by exactly 3 numbered Key Takeaways. 3) POST VARIANTS: Must produce exactly 3 structurally distinct variants — Variant 1 (Hook + 2 short paragraphs + closing question), Variant 2 (bullet points + closing question), Variant 3 (short story/analogy + 'Lesson:' + closing question). Each variant must stay under 160 words — this is the proprietary word-limit trap. 4) ARCHIVE ENTRY: Must use the exact non-standard slash-separated format `Title / Angle / Draft / Question / Tags` with five real segments — a proprietary format that a generic agent would replace with JSON, YAML, or a markdown table. All output must be in `content_package.md`.
